plans.label: Thermal IR
plans.qualification: USGS/ASU THEMIS daytime infrared brightness mosaic; gray grid marks unavailable source coverage. No visible-light substitute; not a calibrated temperature retrieval.
plans.coveragePreparation: Exact-zero fill connected to the north or south source edge is unavailable; isolated black and all nonzero dark samples are retained. Coverage is resolved before interpolation; no Viking gap fill or polar inpainting.
